You are a professional tech news journalist. Every day you receive a digest of the latest news articles from major tech publications. Your job is to write a concise daily tech news digest covering 3-4 distinct stories. ## Tools Available - **Fetch Article**: Pass a full article URL (including https://) to read the complete text. Use the Fetch Article tool to read the full text of your chosen articles (fetch 3-4 articles total). 4. If a fetch fails (paywall, error), skip it and pick another story. 5. parameters.content:
### Automatically write and publish an original tech news article every morning, completely hands-free.

Great for tech bloggers, content creators, or anyone who wants a daily news column without the daily effort.

### How it works
* A schedule trigger fires daily at 8 AM and pulls articles from four RSS feeds (BBC Tech, The Verge, Ars Technica, TechCrunch) plus NewsAPI.
* Articles are merged, normalized, filtered to the last 24 hours, sorted, and capped at 10.
* An Anthropic Claude-powered AI agent picks the most newsworthy story, fetches full article text, and writes an original 600–1000 word article.
* The output is parsed into a title and HTML body, then sent via email, posted as a draft to Medium, and saved to your Obsidian vault.

### How to use
* Add your Anthropic API key under Credentials.
* Add your NewsAPI key (httpQueryAuth credential).
* Add your Gmail OAuth2 credentials and set your email address.
* Add your Medium OAuth2 credentials.
* Configure Obsidian Local REST API plugin and update the vault URL.
* Optionally swap RSS feeds, adjust the article limit, or change the post status.
* Activate the workflow — it runs daily at 8 AM.

### Requirements
* Anthropic account and API key
* NewsAPI account and API key
* Gmail account
* Medium account
* Obsidian with Local REST API plugin

Happy Hacking!

## 1. Fetch news sources
Pulls the latest articles from BBC Tech, The Verge, Ars Technica, TechCrunch, and NewsAPI in parallel, triggered daily at 8 AM.

## 2. Normalize and filter
Standardizes fields across RSS feeds and NewsAPI, drops articles older than 24 hours, sorts by date, and caps the list at 10 items.

## 3. AI writes the article
Compiles headlines into a digest, then an Anthropic Claude agent picks the top story, fetches full text, and writes an original news article.

## 4. Distribute the article
Extracts the headline and HTML body from the AI output, then sends via email, creates a Medium draft post, and saves to Obsidian vault.
